author: cryptowiz0488
content: Hi <@&836981603216654336> team — I found a reproducible **Java heap OOM** in Besu 26.11.0. In an isolated private testnet, a node using an approximately 8 GB maximum heap, consistent with Besu’s [published recommendation](https://docs.besu-eth.org/public-networks/how-to/configure-java/manage-memory), logged `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` and exited. A matched benign control stayed healthy. Docker reported `OOMKilled=false`, so the observed failure was in the JVM heap.
